The '''Armageddon Battalion post''' was a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Armageddon Battalion]] was quartered there until it was persuaded by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] to depart and join the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="Reallocation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armageddon Battalion post appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Reallocation" />
